mapper.update: UPDATE t_archive_category SET path = CONCAT(#{newPrefix}, SUBSTRING(path, CHAR_LENGTH(#{oldPrefix}) + 1)), level = level + #{levelDelta}, update_time = NOW() WHERE del_flag = 0 AND path LIKE CONCAT(#{oldPrefix}, '/%')
UPDATE t_archive_category SET status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE del_flag = 0 AND (path = #{pathPrefix} OR path LIKE CONCAT(#{pathPrefix}, '/%'))
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = SCHEMA() AND TABLE_NAME = #{tableName}
SELECT f.`category_id` AS categoryId, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM `t_archive_file` f WHERE f.`del_flag` = 0 GROUP BY f.`category_id`
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `t_archive_file` f WHERE f.`del_flag` = 0 AND (f.`category_path` = #{categoryPath} OR f.`category_path` LIKE CONCAT(#{categoryPath}, '/%'))
